note: An idealized, handsome prince in a fairy tale; figuratively, an ideal romantic partner.

senses.m: An idealized, handsome prince in a fairy tale
senses.pat: meet/find Prince Charming · wait for Prince Charming · a modern Prince Charming
ex: The story ends when she meets Prince Charming.
Câu chuyện kết thúc khi cô gặp chàng hoàng tử trong mơ.
She said she was not waiting for Prince Charming to solve her problems.
Cô nói mình không chờ hoàng tử trong mơ đến giải quyết vấn đề.

note: The number of copies of a book or other item printed in one production batch.

senses.m: The number of copies of a book or other item printed in one production batch
senses.pat: a small/large print run · a print run of 5,000 copies · increase the print run
ex: The first print run sold out within a week.
Đợt in đầu tiên bán hết trong vòng một tuần.
The publisher ordered a second print run.
Nhà xuất bản đặt in đợt thứ hai.

note: A person or work that has won a prize; can also mean an animal or product judged especially good.

senses.m: A person or work that has won a prize
senses.pat: a Nobel Prize winner · prize-winning novel · prize winner at the festival
ex: The prize winner thanked the judges.
Người đoạt giải cảm ơn ban giám khảo.
The prize-winning film will open the festival.
Bộ phim đoạt giải sẽ khai mạc liên hoan.

note: A day officially designated as a holiday, when many workplaces or services close; names and dates differ by country.

senses.m: A day officially designated as a holiday, when many workplaces or services close
senses.pat: a national public holiday · observe a public holiday · public-holiday schedule
ex: Banks close on the public holiday.
Các ngân hàng đóng cửa vào ngày nghỉ lễ.
Check the public-holiday schedule before booking.
Hãy kiểm tra lịch ngày nghỉ lễ trước khi đặt chỗ.

note: A room housing pumps or associated equipment; in older buildings, sometimes a fashionable place where visitors drank spa water.

senses.m: A room housing pumps or associated equipment
senses.pat: enter the pump room · a water-pump room · historic pump room
ex: The maintenance team inspected the pump room.
Đội bảo trì kiểm tra phòng máy bơm.
The historic pump room now hosts concerts.
Phòng bơm khoáng lịch sử nay tổ chức hòa nhạc.

note: A large bowl used to serve punch, a mixed drink; may include a ladle.

senses.m: A large bowl used to serve punch, a mixed drink
senses.pat: a bowl of punch · serve punch from a punch bowl · punch-bowl ladle
ex: The host filled the punch bowl with fruit drink.
Chủ nhà đổ nước trái cây vào tô đựng punch.
Guests helped themselves from the punch bowl.
Khách tự rót đồ uống từ tô punch.

note: To record the end of a work shift using a time clock; also to hit someone, or to cut a shape out of material.

senses.m: To record the end of a work shift using a time clock
senses.pat: punch out at five · punch out a hole · punch someone out
ex: She punched out at the time clock and went home.
Cô chấm công tan ca rồi về nhà.
Use the tool to punch out a circle from the card.
Dùng dụng cụ để đục một hình tròn khỏi tấm bìa.

note: To make something more lively or forceful; also to hit someone, or in film editing to intensify sound or color.

senses.m: To make something more lively or forceful
senses.pat: punch up a speech · punch up the colors · punch up a character
ex: The editor punched up the opening scene with brighter music.
Biên tập viên làm cảnh mở đầu sôi động hơn bằng nhạc tươi sáng.
She added an example to punch up the presentation.
Cô thêm một ví dụ để bài thuyết trình hấp dẫn hơn.

note: A young person’s intense but often short-lived romantic feelings; can sound dismissive of those feelings.

senses.m: A young person’s intense but often short-lived romantic feelings
senses.pat: a case of puppy love · first puppy love · dismiss something as puppy love
ex: They remembered their school romance as puppy love.
Họ nhớ lại mối tình thời học sinh như tình cảm tuổi mới lớn.
Her parents called it puppy love, but the feelings were real to her.
Cha mẹ gọi đó là tình cảm trẻ con, nhưng với cô cảm xúc ấy là thật.

note: A US military decoration awarded to service members wounded or killed in action; capitalize when referring to the medal.

senses.m: A US military decoration awarded to service members wounded or killed in action
senses.pat: receive/earn a Purple Heart · Purple Heart medal · a Purple Heart recipient
ex: He received a Purple Heart after being wounded in combat.
Anh nhận Huân chương Trái tim Tím sau khi bị thương trong chiến đấu.
The museum displayed a Purple Heart medal.
Bảo tàng trưng bày Huân chương Trái tim Tím.

note: One of four traditional days in Britain when rents and other payments fell due; dates and relevance vary historically.

senses.m: One of four traditional days in Britain when rents and other payments fell due
senses.pat: a traditional quarter day · rent due on quarter day · quarter-day payment
ex: The tenant paid the rent on the traditional quarter day.
Người thuê trả tiền nhà vào ngày thanh toán định kỳ truyền thống.
The old account book lists payments by quarter day.
Sổ kế toán cũ liệt kê các khoản thanh toán theo kỳ.

note: A note lasting one quarter of a whole note in common notation; British English calls it a crotchet.

senses.m: A note lasting one quarter of a whole note in common notation
senses.pat: play a quarter note · quarter-note rhythm · count quarter notes
ex: The rhythm begins with four quarter notes.
Nhịp điệu bắt đầu bằng bốn nốt đen.
She held the quarter note for one beat.
Cô ngân nốt đen trong một phách.

note: The reproductive female in a bee colony; figuratively, a dominant woman in a social group, sometimes disparaging.

senses.m: The reproductive female in a bee colony
senses.pat: a queen bee lays eggs · the queen bee of the group · queen-bee behavior
ex: The queen bee laid eggs in the hive.
Ong chúa đẻ trứng trong tổ.
The article criticized the stereotype of the office queen bee.
Bài viết phê phán khuôn mẫu “nữ hoàng” nơi công sở.

note: A blow to the back of the head or neck, especially in boxing; dangerous and prohibited in many sports.

senses.m: A blow to the back of the head or neck, especially in boxing
senses.pat: deliver a rabbit punch · illegal rabbit punch · ban rabbit punches
ex: The referee warned the boxer after a rabbit punch.
Trọng tài cảnh cáo võ sĩ sau cú đánh vào sau đầu.
A rabbit punch can cause serious neck injury.
Cú đánh vào sau đầu có thể gây chấn thương cổ nghiêm trọng.

note: A network of underground tunnels and chambers made by rabbits; figuratively, a confusing maze of narrow passages or rooms.

senses.m: A network of underground tunnels and chambers made by rabbits
senses.pat: a rabbit warren of tunnels · a housing rabbit warren · get lost in a rabbit warren
ex: The old building was a rabbit warren of corridors.
Tòa nhà cũ là mê cung hành lang chằng chịt.
Rabbits dug a warren under the hedge.
Thỏ đào hang dưới hàng rào cây.

note: A car designed or adapted for motor racing; also race car, especially in US English.

senses.m: A car designed or adapted for motor racing
senses.pat: drive a racing car · racing-car driver · racing-car circuit
ex: The racing car accelerated out of the corner.
Chiếc xe đua tăng tốc khi thoát khỏi khúc cua.
She trained as a racing-car driver.
Cô được đào tạo làm tay đua ô tô.

note: An electromagnetic wave used to transmit radio signals; radio waves are part of the electromagnetic spectrum.

senses.m: An electromagnetic wave used to transmit radio signals
senses.pat: transmit radio waves · radio-wave frequency · detect radio waves
ex: The antenna receives radio waves from distant stations.
Ăng-ten thu sóng vô tuyến từ các đài ở xa.
Radio waves can travel through space.
Sóng vô tuyến có thể truyền qua không gian.

note: Any of a group of 17 chemical elements, including the lanthanides plus scandium and yttrium; they are not necessarily geologically rare.

senses.m: Any of a group of 17 chemical elements, including the lanthanides plus scandium and yttrium
senses.pat: rare-earth elements · rare-earth minerals · rare-earth supply
ex: The device contains rare-earth elements used in its magnets.
Thiết bị chứa các nguyên tố đất hiếm dùng trong nam châm.
The country is investing in rare-earth processing.
Quốc gia đang đầu tư vào chế biến đất hiếm.

note: An old form of tennis played indoors on a walled court; also called court tennis or royal tennis.

senses.m: An old form of tennis played indoors on a walled court
senses.pat: play real tennis · a real-tennis court · real-tennis championship
ex: The club preserves the tradition of real tennis.
Câu lạc bộ gìn giữ truyền thống môn quần vợt cổ.
Real tennis is played on a court with unusual walls and openings.
Môn real tennis được chơi trên sân có tường và cửa mở đặc biệt.

note: A senior naval officer rank; its level and responsibilities vary among countries and navies.

senses.m: A senior naval officer rank
senses.pat: a rear admiral in the navy · promote someone to rear admiral · rear-admiral rank
ex: The rear admiral addressed the crew.
Chuẩn đô đốc phát biểu với thủy thủ đoàn.
She was promoted to rear admiral after decades of service.
Bà được thăng hàm chuẩn đô đốc sau nhiều thập kỷ phục vụ.
